labels.label: bzprop:c1s2p2_base_cone
findings: Witness only (the label is WP-45n's, MARKED in its corrected form in Cone/Base, DEC-124). DEC-122 FINDING, formalized for every Benzécri dimension n = m + 3 ≥ 3 (DEC-124; Lean ConeBase (m + 2) (VDim m)): W = {v : v₂ > 0, (v₀,v₁) ≠ 0} ⊂ ℝⁿ∖0 and A = diag(4, 1/8, 2, 1, …, 1) ∈ GU(n); the ℤ-action k·v = A^k v is free and properly discontinuous; V = W/⟨A⟩ is Hausdorff, second countable, connected and paracompact, an affine conical manifold with cone charts f_N = (proj|N)⁻¹ on N(i,r) = {r v₂ < |v_i| < 2 r v₂} (i = 0, 1) and transitions A^k; its base is NOT Hausdorff ([(1,0,…)] and [(0,1,…)] inseparable: y_k = proj(1, 16^{-k}, 1, 0, …) → proj(1,0,1,0,…) while 2^k·y_k = proj(2^{-k}, 1, 1, 0, …) → proj(0,1,1,0,…)). Prop. 2 read with a « variété » base is the Prop Benzecri.ConeCex.Prop2HausdorffBaseAsReadDim n, refuted for every n ≥ 2 (Lean's base dimension) by Benzecri.ConeCex.not_prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead_dim; Benzécri's n = 3 keeps the wave-3 names (Prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead = Prop2HausdorffBaseAsReadDim 2, not_prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead).
